title: harness project config
description: Project-specific values pvmalove-suite's qa-gate, pr-composer, code-review, to-guide, and the check-branch-name.sh/check-worktree-branch-name.sh hooks read. Written once by 'harness init'/'adopt'/'update' when pvmalove-suite is selected (harness/bin/harness, scaffold_pvmalove_extras) and safe to hand-edit afterward - see docs/adr/0003 and CONTEXT.md ("Проектный конфиг"). This schema is editor-facing only (autocomplete/validation); 'harness health' enforces the same rules by hand, since this repo has no jsonschema dependency to load this file at runtime.

$schema.description: Points editors at this file; not read by any harness code.

language.description: Output language for code-review reports and the PR body template.

base_branch.description: Project release/base branch. /to-spec creates each epic's integration/<service-or-team> branch from it; it is also the fallback base for work without an epic.

branch_pattern.description: Regex a new branch name must match, enforced by check-branch-name.sh/check-worktree-branch-name.sh. If this file is missing entirely, the hooks fall back to their own built-in default (^feature/issue-[0-9]+-.+) instead of blocking every branch name - that fallback does not apply if this field is merely empty.

qa_gate_commands.description: Lint/typecheck/test commands qa-gate runs in order before a PR opens. An empty list is valid here but qa-gate refuses to silently skip on one - it stops and asks you to fill this in rather than treating an empty list as 'no checks configured, proceed'.

shell.description: Shell qa-gate wraps each qa_gate_commands entry in before running it. 'bash' (default when this field is absent) runs 'bash -lc <command>' - correct on Linux/macOS and inside WSL. 'powershell' runs 'powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command <command>' - use this on a native Windows checkout, where a bare 'bash' on PATH can resolve to the System32 WSL launcher stub ahead of Git Bash and fail if no WSL distro is configured, even for a command that needs no shell at all.

story_points.description: Fibonacci story-point scale and pipeline::fast/pipeline::full routing thresholds that to-tickets, /implement, and /fast-implement read without depending on the optional backend-orchestration capability (see docs/tasks/issue-165-planning-poker/issue-165-spec-planning-poker.md). Optional field - a project without it has no story-point routing configured.

scale.description: Fibonacci-like story-point values to-tickets may assign (1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, ...).

fast_threshold.description: Score at or below which to-tickets proposes pipeline::fast (score <= fast_threshold).

full_threshold.description: Score at or above which to-tickets proposes pipeline::full (score >= full_threshold).

gray_zone.description: The single score strictly between fast_threshold and full_threshold that triggers a second advisory scoring pass in to-tickets.
